description: This header file declares a C++ class 'hostIf_StorageSrvc' which provides an interface for managing Storage Service information via TR-069 protocol. It includes methods for instance management, message handling, and attribute setting related to storage services in a network device context.

classes.name: hostIf_StorageSrvc
classes.description: A singleton class providing APIs to manage and access storage service information within a device, including instance management, message handling, and thread safety mechanisms.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the storage service class for a specified device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a specified storage service instance.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all existing storage service instances.

methods.name: get_Device_StorageSrvc_ClientNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of client entries in the storage service.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for storage service attributes.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set requests for storage service attributes.

methods.name: getLock
methods.description: Obtains a mutex lock for thread safety.

methods.name: releaseLock
methods.description: Releases the previously acquired mutex lock.
